svg.title: How NoticeOS works
svg.desc: Data sources on the left (Google Analytics, Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, PostHog and Clarity, Mediavine, revenue and cost files, and your own nightly report) feed NoticeOS in the middle, which collects on a schedule, checks for unusual days, stores every row in Postgres and keeps one task database shared by people and agents. On the right, the Tower web app, the Wall TV view and coding agents connected through MCP read from it.
svg.text: Moving dashes show data being read or sent
